sn52.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Anuruddho Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Andhavanasmiṃ ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 2.
sn52.10:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yenāyasmā Anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Anuruddham etad avocuṃ ||
sn52.10:2.1: Katamenāyasmato Anuruddhassa vihārena viharato uppannā sārīrikā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhantī ti || ||
sn52.10:2.2: Catūsu me āvuso satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittassa viharato uppannā sārīrikā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti || ||
sn52.10:2.7: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn52.10:2.8: Imesu kho me āvuso catusu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittassa viharato uppannā sārīrikā dukkhā vedanā cittam na pariyādāya tiṭṭhantī ti || ||
